description: This file defines functions to generate dashboard configurations and retrieve account information within an ERP system, specifically for dashboard charts related to company financial data and project summaries.

methods.name: get_company_for_dashboards
methods.description: Retrieves the current company for dashboards, defaulting to the first available if not explicitly set.

methods.name: get_default_dashboards
methods.description: Generates a default dashboard configuration with charts for financial and project data based on the current company.

methods.name: get_account
methods.description: Fetches the account name for a given account type and company.
